player_prompt.intro:
Uri gukina Mastermind.
Urihagije kubona kodi iyobora {code_length} tarakimu zirebwa, tarakimu zose zikaba ziva kuri 1 hadi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Mu kibazo cyawe, mushobora kubika ugushushanya wawe mu ruhusa rufuata: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Nyuma ya kibazo cyawe, mushobora kubona ibikubwira mu ruhusa rwa pegs za blaki na blanche.
Ipeg za blaki zibikubwira tarakimu nguhu mu ngingo nguhu, ikaba pegs za blanche zibikubwira tarakimu nguhu mu ngingo siyo nguhu.
Urihagije {max_turns} gukina kubika kodi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntimwasubije mu gutanga urutonde rw'imibare irimwo ibibanza vyitandukanije, ishirwa hagati y'ibinogo bigororotse.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ibivugwa vyose bitegerezwa kuba ari ibiharuro vy'ukuri.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Mu gutahura, hategerezwa kuba harimwo ibiharuro {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Imibare yose itegerezwa kuba iri hagati ya 1 na {num_numbers}.

game_action.feedback: Watumise [{guess}]. Ivyo vyagenze: {black_pegs} vimwimbi vy'umwiru, {white_pegs} vimwimbi vy'umweru.

outcome.win: Wakayaye ikododi, ukamenya {black_pegs} kati ya {code_length} vimwimbi vy'ukuri
outcome.turn_limit: Uwufise uburenganzira bwo guhindukira yarashitse. Warihaye {percent} ku ijana vy'ibiharuro neza.
